rubric_items.reason: All eleven known REQs are traced: REQ-1..4 by S-1, REQ-5..7 by S-2, REQ-8..10 by S-3, REQ-11 by S-4. No assumed REQs.
REQ-11 moved to its own story S-4 (prior F-4 addressed). S-3 still groups the doctor link with the two data-exclusion constraints, but they are small and closely related.

ACs are Given/When/Then and discriminating: S-2 covers changed-after-booking and each Inactive partition, S-3 now checks the received data, S-4 covers every status. Cancelled partition checks fewer fields; fee grouping still untested.
The only values (50000 and 12345 paise) are converted to rupees inline using the glossary paise definition; (Inactive) marker comes from A-01.
Terms match the intent and glossary; body matches front matter; resolved findings and the open Q-02 are stated clearly.
